outcome: Report what a semantic join did to its inputs on the successful response (issue 17, item 1): for every join step, the left rows and keys that matched, the ones that matched nothing, the left keys that matched several right rows and the rows that added, with bounded samples, as data facts separate from advice, so an agent can see a join that dropped some rows and multiplied others while the row count stayed the same
criteria: With the issue's reproduction (probe_left holding accounts A and B, probe_right holding account A twice, an inner join on account), transform_dataset still succeeds with the same two rows, and its response carries a joins entry for that step reporting 2 left rows, 1 matched and 1 unmatched left row and key, 1 left key matching several right rows that added 1 row, a match coverage of 0.5, and bounded samples naming account B as unmatched and account A with 2 right rows; its advice has kinds join_multiplied_rows and join_unmatched_rows, and says that the unchanged row count hides one dropped and one added row

A join whose right keys are unique and all matched reports full coverage, no multiplication and no join advice; left rows with a null key are counted as null_key_left_rows among the unmatched rows and are never sampled as keys; a left join says its unmatched rows are kept with nulls in the right columns; a many-to-many join that is meant reports its multiplication as a fact, and its advice names the choices (reduce the right side per key first, semi_join, or keep the join) without calling it wrong; every join returns the same rows and schema as before

Scope and cost are stated and hold: diagnostics cover semantic join steps of every how, not semi_join, not joins written inside raw_query SQL and not steps after a raw_query first step; each diagnosed step costs one grouped query over its left input and right dataset plus one bounded sample query only when rows are unmatched or multiplied; a diagnostic that fails never fails the transform; Backend(join_diagnostics=False) and agent-backend-mcp --no-join-diagnostics turn them off. README.md, the transform_dataset tool description and the recovery module docstring say so, and tests under tests/ cover each case above with fixtures unrelated to DataSpace

note: Executor counts each semantic join step with two statements from SqlCompiler.compile_join_facts: one grouped FULL JOIN of the left input's and the right version's key groups gives the counts, and a sample query runs only when a non-null key is unmatched or a key matches several right rows. JoinFacts goes to the response as joins and to advise_joins (join_multiplied_rows, join_unmatched_rows; explained, never rewritten). The identifier hint in join_unmatched_rows is only added when coverage is below one half. tests/test_join_diagnostics.py has 13 tests; the backend suite passes (434). The 8 media tests in tests/test_audio.py and tests/test_perception.py fail before and after this change because the local FFmpeg lacks a video encoder.
